ios.desc:
One emoji can hold an entire secret.

Hide a private message inside an ordinary emoji, share it in any chat, and let someone discover what is really there. To everyone else, it looks like just another emoji.

Imp makes secret texting simple, private, and much more fun.

ONE EMOJI. ONE SECRET.

Some things feel different when they are written plainly in a normal conversation.

A confession. An inside joke. A private thought. A surprise. Something you have wanted to say but cannot quite send as ordinary text.

With Imp, the emoji becomes part of the message. Choose something innocent, suspicious, romantic, funny, or unexpected. The recipient sees the emoji first. The secret stays hidden until they reveal it with Imp.

HOW IMP WORKS

1. Write the message you want to hide.
2. Choose an emoji to use as its cover.
3. Select how you want to share it.
4. Send it through the messaging app you already use.
5. The recipient reveals the hidden message with Imp.

There is no separate social network and no additional inbox to manage.

TWO WAYS TO SHARE

SEND JUST THE EMOJI

Choose the most mysterious option and send only the secret emoji. It looks ordinary inside the conversation. To reveal the message, the recipient shares the emoji to Imp.

SEND WITH A REVEAL LINK

Include a reveal link when you want to make opening the secret easier. The recipient taps the link and opens the hidden message with Imp.

You decide whether the message arrives with a clear way to reveal it or remains disguised as an ordinary emoji.

MADE FOR MESSAGES THAT NEED SOMETHING EXTRA

Imp gives private messages a sense of curiosity, surprise, and playfulness.

Use it to:

• Tell someone how you really feel
• Send a confession without saying everything openly
• Share an inside joke only your friends understand
• Hide a clue or surprise
• Send a romantic message to your partner
• Make a group chat more interesting
• Share a secret note with a friend
• Turn a simple emoji into a prank

USE THE APPS YOU ALREADY HAVE

Imp is not another messaging app.

Create the hidden message in Imp, then send the emoji through Messages, WhatsApp, Instagram, or another app where you can paste and share an emoji.

Your conversations stay where they already are. Imp simply adds a hidden layer to them.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN

Your message is encrypted before it is shared and concealed inside the emoji you select.
